entries.title: Cloud Saves + a Bigger Editor
notes: Never lose a project: all 10 save slots now back up to the cloud, not just the one you are in - a browser wipe can no longer take your work
Import a project straight from the Project card, right next to Export
Game maker engine 2.2.0 to 2.3.0 across dozens of builds
Push blocks and push-stops now work in top-down rooms, and blocks ride conveyor belts in every mode
New Block Reset switch: step on it in play and every push block snaps home, so puzzle rooms are replayable
Per-sprite animation speed (half to 3x) on the new x-chip in the FRAMES row
Heroes auto-generate 5 pose variants - walk, side, jump, hurt, morph - and switch between them in play
Room background randomizer: hue, vivid, light and grain sliders plus 5 patterns, saved per room
Gates and switches now come in 4 color channels for layered lock puzzles
Paintable fog-of-war that reveals permanently as the player explores
Ramp tiles the hero slides along, two decor layers, and decor on FPS walls, floors and ceilings
World map view with drag-to-arrange rooms, per-room music and SFX, scene transitions and story pages
Timers with HUD chips and logic actions, a song and SFX bank, and an FX rack (echo, distortion, phaser)
Paint custom skins on any entity, custom weapon sprites, and a co-op sidekick pet on a second gamepad
Account data locked down tighter behind the scenes

entries.title: Engine 2.2.0 + Account Sprint
notes: Game maker: engine 2.1.0 to 2.2.0, 30+ builds of fixes and features
Game maker: BloomQuest sample project baked in so there is something to play with
Forgot your password? Reset link now works, straight from the sign in screen
Fixed: intro screen could block sign in on some browsers. Gone.
Sidebar collapses now, more room for the work
Mobile: layout and keyboard fixes throughout
Skyline ticker on the home screen

entries.title: Game Maker Engine 2.1.0
notes: Game maker updated: BloomDesktop engine 2.0.3 to 2.1.0

entries.title: Makeover Day
notes: Desktop redesign: sidebar navigation, fullscreen layout
New tab: game maker - build games right inside Spiralside
Split screen: drag the divider to resize, double-click to reset
Header buttons: hide/show tabs, split screen
New minimal startup screen - straight into the app
Chat: comfortable reading width on big monitors
Tip: drag tabs in the sidebar to reorder them - it saves
